name: File & Archive Management
description: Provides file and directory creation, copying, moving, trash deletion, lock detection, text IO, 7z/Zip archiving, and folder monitoring.

CompressFile.description: Compress or decompress files and directories using Zip, 7z, or Tar formats with optional encryption.

CopyFile.description: Copy a single file or recursively duplicate an entire directory tree.

CreateFolder.description: Recursively create new directories with optional cleanup if already existing.

DeleteFile.description: Safely move files or folders to the system trash or permanently delete them.

DirectoryIterator.description: Scan and iterate files and subdirectories with extension wildcard filtering.

FileLock.description: Detect whether a file is locked by external applications like Excel or Word, with timeout polling.

FileQuery.description: Check file existence, file size, directory status, and last modification timestamp.

FileRead.description: Read complete text or binary data from disk into memory.

FileWrite.description: Save text or binary buffer content to a file on disk.

ImageLoad.description: Load image files into memory Image objects.

ImageSave.description: Save memory Image objects or export directly as PDF files.

MoveFile.description: Move or rename files and folders across disk drives and volumes.

ReadLines.description: Split and read large text files line by line into string array lists.

StandardPath.description: Retrieve standard system directories like Desktop, Documents, Downloads, AppData, and Temp.

TempFile.description: Generate unique temporary files or directories in the OS temp folder.

WatchFolder.description: Monitor folder file creation, modification, and deletion events in real time with timeout.
